# Soak USA — Full LLM Content Index

> Soak USA is a directory of hot springs, natural thermal pools, and geothermal soaking spots across the United States.

## About
- Domain: soakusa.net
- Type: Location directory — 1,476+ hot spring and natural soaking locations
- Coverage: All 50 US states
- Data: GPS coordinates, water temperatures, amenities, access requirements, safety information

## Navigation
- [Home](https://soakusa.net)
- [Editorial](https://soakusa.net/editorial)

- [Contact](https://soakusa.net/contact)
